replies.author: Spartemex
replies.body:
Well there is W.E. for single player, but if it is single player, then how will other people be involved?

If you are looking to start a map with them, then contact them on skype, or some other private messenger. Threads in Map Making are for people to collaborate with each other on existing maps that they are working, and for the community to see the project.
